title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, Sec. 94G, as amended by jSt. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 592-A, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of May, June & July, 1989. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
